name: dumbbell incline powell raise
description: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Complete your reps and switch sides.
